questions.q: A client wants to know, just this once, which supplier invoices are over $10,000 and more than 30 days past due. Which tool fits best?
options: BI Publisher, scheduled weekly
Financial Reporting Studio
OTBI, built as a quick ad hoc analysis
Smart View Report Packages
questions.explain: A one-time question where exact layout doesn't matter is exactly what OTBI's ad hoc analysis is built for.

questions.q: A compliance team needs 1099 forms generated in a precise required layout and emailed automatically to vendors every January. Which tool fits best?
options: OTBI
BI Publisher, scheduled
Smart View ad hoc analysis
The Reports and Analytics panel tab alone
questions.explain: A precise required layout plus unattended, scheduled delivery is the core use case for BI Publisher run through Scheduled Processes.

questions.q: Why is "just export it to Excel" not a complete answer to a reporting request by itself?
options: Excel cannot connect to Oracle Fusion data at all
It skips the real decision — a one-time export is fine, but rebuilding a recurring scheduled report by hand wastes time BI Publisher could automate
Smart View is not related to Excel in any way
Oracle Fusion blocks all Excel exports
questions.explain: Smart View is Excel-based, so exporting is sometimes right — but using it as a reflex for recurring, schedulable reports introduces manual effort and error that automation would avoid.

questions.q: A finance team needs a signed-off board package that combines written commentary from five contributors with financial numbers. Which tool is designed for this?
options: OTBI dashboards
Financial Reporting Studio alone
Smart View Report Packages
The Scheduled Processes work area
questions.explain: Report Packages provide the collaborative author, review, and sign-off workflow this kind of narrative deliverable requires.

questions.q: A request asks for both a live dashboard the AP team checks every morning and a PDF emailed to the controller every Friday. What is the best approach?
options: Force BI Publisher to handle both needs with one report
Force OTBI to handle both needs with one analysis
Recognize this is two separate needs: an OTBI dashboard for daily viewing, and a scheduled BI Publisher report for the Friday PDF
Tell the requester this cannot be done in Oracle Fusion
questions.explain: Layered requests often need more than one tool; a good consultant splits them rather than forcing a single tool to do a job it wasn't built for.
